enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe regularly. Remain still. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Bend knees. Move right arm. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow. Scratch nose. Turn to back. Stretch legs. Sleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Sit up. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wash face. Dry face. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off tap. Turn off light.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs and milk. Close refrigerator. Crack eggs into bowl. Whisk eggs. Turn on stove. Pour oil into pan. Pour eggs into pan. Stir. Turn off stove. Place eggs on plate. Sit at table. Eat breakfast. Drink milk.

enriched_activities.activity: Changing into work clothes and packing work bag
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open closet. Take out work clothes. Close closet. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Open drawer. Take out work bag. Place stethoscope in bag. Place notebook in bag. Place pen in bag. Zip bag. Pick up bag. Walk out of bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the hospital for the day shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap transit card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Stand up. Walk to exit. Tap card. Exit bus. Walk to hospital entrance. Enter hospital.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional, providing patient care and completing clinical duties
enriched_activities.desc: Enter hospital. Walk to locker room. Change into scrubs. Walk to nurses' station. Pick up patient list. Walk to patient room. Knock on door. Enter room. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Measure blood pressure. Record notes. Administer medication. Walk to cafeteria. Eat lunch. Walk back to nurses' station. Complete paperwork. Walk to locker room. Change into street clothes.
Walk out of hospital. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap transit card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Stand up. Walk to exit. Tap card. Exit bus. Walk home. Enter home.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Close refrigerator. Place on counter. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Pour oil. Add meat. Stir. Add vegetables. Stir. Turn off stove. Place food on plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Stand up. Place plate in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Clearing the table and washing dishes
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up plates. Scrape food into trash. Place plates in sink. Pick up glasses. Place glasses in sink. Pick up utensils. Place utensils in sink. Turn on tap. Apply soap to sponge. Wash plates. Rinse plates. Place plates in drying rack. Wash glasses. Rinse glasses. Place glasses in drying rack. Wash utensils. Rinse utensils. Place utensils in drying rack. Turn off tap. Wipe counter with cloth. Wipe table with cloth.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a shower and changing into comfortable clothes
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Take off clothes. Step into shower. Turn on shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rub body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Wrap towel. Walk to bedroom. Open drawer. Take out comfortable clothes. Put on t-shirt. Put on sweatpants.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa and watching TV
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Turn on TV. Pick up remote. Sit on sofa. Change channel. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out snack. Close refrigerator. Walk back to living room. Sit on sofa. Eat snack. Watch TV. Pick up remote. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Browsing the phone and reviewing notes for tomorrow's shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit on bed. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open browser. Scroll through news. Open social media. Like post. Close social media. Open notes app. Read notes. Close notes app. Place phone on nightstand. Pick up notebook. Open notebook. Read notes. Close notebook. Place notebook on nightstand. Turn off bedside lamp. Lie down.

enriched_activities.activity: Evening wash and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wash face. Dry face. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk to bedroom.

Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe regularly. Remain still. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Bend knees. Move right arm. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow. Scratch nose. Turn to back. Stretch legs. Sleep.
